review_notes: Corrected for consistency with vv.60, 67 and 68: the supplied copula of a verbless enumeration clause joins the numeral the English copula stands before. *was* moves from the דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים unit to שְׁתֵּי, and neither unit is discontinuous any longer.

The superseded reading put *was* on the predicate's head noun *darics*; the verse's own note recorded that as contested. The corpus decides it: מֵאָה → *was a hundred* in 13 units, with *was forty*, *were forty*, *was five*, *was seven*, *was six*, *was threescore*, *was fifty* and *were two hundred* alongside, and no unit moving the copula off the numeral.
All other units are unaffected and are reproduced unchanged.
